speaking — Part 1

Part 1: Social Interaction You will answer questions about two topics. Answer each question naturally. Topic 1 - Scenery in your area 1. What scenery is there in the area where you live? 2. How can a home get a beautiful view? 3. Do you like taking photos of scenery in the park? Topic 2 - Art galleries 1. Do you like going to art galleries? 2. What exhibitions do you usually go to see? 3. Do you decorate your home with art pictures?

speaking — Part 2

Situation: You must decide which type of company you would prefer to work for. You are considering the following options: 1. A foreign company 2. A Vietnamese company 3. A family company Which one would you choose? Why?

speaking — Part 3

Topic: The benefits of electric vehicles (EVs). Ideas: - Lower running costs - Less air and noise pollution - Better for the environment - Your own idea Further questions: 1. Do you think electric vehicles will replace other types of vehicles in the future? 2. Are electric vehicles popular in your area? 3. What could be done to encourage more people to use electric vehicles?
